scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:e2e:prod: node -e "process.env.E2E_BASE_URL='https://servespot-petsyys-projects.vercel.app'; require('child_process').execSync('npx playwright test e2e/production-smoke.spec.js', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env })"
scripts.test:e2e:prod:headed: node -e "process.env.E2E_BASE_URL='https://servespot-petsyys-projects.vercel.app'; require('child_process').execSync('npx playwright test e2e/production-smoke.spec.js --headed --workers=1', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env })"
